smallest_blocker: The release capsule was produced from this working tree, not regenerated from a fresh clone at the pinned commits. Every other Gate D condition now holds. REPRODUCIBLE_CROSS_REPOSITORY_APERTURE_RELEASES stays at 0 until one capsule is rebuilt from scratch and its hashes match.

ci_history.root_cause: git exit 128 on cross-repository checkout; DALEOBANKS' default GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to its own repository and cannot read uniimente-kernel
ci_history.fix: vendored the exact wheels with recorded SHA256 instead of building from a cross-repo checkout; needs no credential
ci_history.preferred_fix: read-only PAT for uniimente-kernel as a DALEOBANKS secret (founder decision)
